The '''Irnaj Sector''' was located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="TEA" /> and [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]]<ref name="Western Reaches" /> of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Irnaj sector was among the first sectors to throw off the Empire.<ref name="RECG" />
